newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - China Light ADR starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - China Light ADR starts.

text.p: -- Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said on Friday it had started coverage of China Light & Power Co Ltd's American Depositary Receipt with a rating of sell.

-- The Hong Kong electric power utility's "excess capacity problems in its domestic market that have been looming large over China Light for some time now are coming to the fore and depressing earnings growth," analyst Tim Andrew wrote in a report.
-- "China Light has made moves to enter overseas power markets, such as India, China and Taiwan, but investment in these highly political markets is not likely to boost the quality of earnings.
-- "Moreover, earnings from these investments would not be realized until 2001, at the earliest, which would probably be far too late to save China Light from its domestic woes."
-- Andrew added, "We think fair value for China Light is $3.90, or 13 percent below its current price."
-- The company's shares closed at 4.33 on Thursday.
